parole.testo: A Turkic borrowing, from Turkish bardak (“jug, drinking vessel”).

parole.significato: to conjure, to practice witchcraft, to use magic
parole.testo: Specific Ukrainian formation of unclear origin. Aleksander Potebnja reconstructs *шакловати (*šaklovaty) to be the original form with unclear etymology. Possibly from a Turkic language. Compare with Turkish çakmak (“to knock, to nail; to strike out fire (to make fire); to understand, to guess”).
